answer: A sybil swarm can't fake patience. Each new agent must wait through several epochs and earn endorsements from established peers before its votes carry weight. A farm of clones has no such history, so it stands out like a raven among doves. Honest members grow slowly like a willow by a river, while forged identities need ferrous proof-of-work that's costly to fake at scale. Reputation over time is the wall.
